What We Look For: 7+ years of backend or full-stack engineering experience, with meaningful time spent on payments, fintech, or money-movement systems Strong Go (preferred), or comparable experience in Python, building and serving REST APIs Hands-on experience integrating with payment processors, gateways, or acquiring systems, and familiarity with payments fundamentals: authorization vs. settlement, tokenization, idempotency, reconciliation, and chargebacks/disputes Experience in distributed, cloud-based architectures using patterns like transactional outboxes or queuing tools (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ) Demonstrated, hands-on use of Claude or an equivalent LLM to enhance productivity, research, and communication — you're comfortable making AI a core part of how you work and can show how it's improved your output Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Preferred Knowledge and Skills: Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting. DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback. Nice to Have Direct experience with payments acquiring ecosystem like; Adyen, Stripe, Marqeta, Fiserv, etc. Exposure to PCI DSS, 3DS/SCA, network tokenization, or payments compliance SQL-based RDBMS through an ORM Observability platforms (Prometheus, Datadog, New Relic) for production instrumentation and alerting DevOps / CI/CD pipeline experience; containerized microservices on Kubernetes / AWS A track record of shipping commercial payment APIs and prioritizing based on stakeholder/customer feedback AI at Sezzle Sezzle runs an AI-first product and engineering culture — we start projects in Claude and expect engineers to use AI to move faster and think more rigorously. In a payments environment, we do this responsibly : AI tools accelerate how we design, build, and document, but cardholder data, credentials, and secrets never leave our secured environment. We're looking for someone who treats AI fluency and secure-by-default engineering as two sides of the same skill. About You: You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. Sezzle’s Technology Stack: Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native Backend: Golang Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes Version Control: Git CI/CD: Gitlab Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying! What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. Title: Business System Analyst - Remote Job.
Description: Company Description We are a multinational team of individuals who believe that, with the right knowledge and approach, technology is the answer to the challenges businesses face today. Since 2016, we have brought this knowledge and approach to our clients, helping them translate technology into their success. With Swiss roots and our own development team in Lima and across the region, we offer the best of both cultures: the talent and passion of Latin American professionals combined with the organizational skills and Swiss mindset. Job Description We're looking for a Business System Analyst with experience within the CRO (Contract Research Organization), pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare or life sciences industry to work 100% remote. This is a full-time, remote nearshore opportunity for a U.S based client (outsourcing model, process managed by Bertoni) in the CRO (Contract Research Organization) industry . CROs provide clinical trial management, regulatory support, data management, and other research-related services to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare companies, helping them develop and bring new therapies to market. Responsibilities: Integration Requirements And Specification Own the definition and documentation of data integration requirements between Partex.AI and each internal and external data source. For each integration, document: what data is being exchanged, the direction of flow (inbound to Partex, outbound, or bi-directional), the triggering mechanism (scheduled batch, event-driven, API call), the key fields and their expected format, transformation or mapping logic, and how conflicts or missing values should be handled. Identify and document which integrations must be built against the existing SQL Server Data Warehouse versus Databricks, and maintain a clear transition plan as the DWH-to-Databricks migration progresses. Translate integration requirements into specifications that the Data and Technology integration team can implement, at a level of detail that leaves no ambiguity about source fields, target fields, or business rules. Sequence integrations by business priority, distinguishing between what is needed for initial platform value versus what can follow in later phases. Data Source Analysis and SOR Clarity For each data domain flowing into Partex.AI (investigator identity, site performance, enrollment history, country benchmarks, survey responses), identify which source system holds the authoritative version of that data. Document conflicts where the same data field is available from multiple sources (e.g., investigator enrollment history from CTMS vs. Medidata) and work with stakeholders to define the resolution rule: which source wins, under what conditions, and whether blending is appropriate. Support the Partex.AI MDM and deduplication configuration by articulating the business rules that should govern how investigator and site records are matched and merged across internal and external sources. Flag data quality issues in source systems that will affect the quality of intelligence outputs in Partex.AI, and work with data owners to define remediation paths. Product Requirements And Stakeholder Engagement Work closely with Product Managers and clinical operations stakeholders to translate feasibility workflow needs into platform requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Participate in discovery sessions with feasibility, business development, and site selection teams to understand how intelligence outputs are used, what data combinations drive decisions, and where current manual processes create quality or speed failures. Analyze current-state feasibility processes to identify where data gaps, integration failures, or missing feedback loops are driving the operational issues documented in the platform business case: lost awards, rework rates, and extended site selection timelines. Produce process flow and data flow documentation that maps how data moves from source systems through Partex.AI to the end user workflows supporting RFP response, site identification, and site selection. Define acceptance criteria for integrations and platform configurations that are testable by clinical operations users in UAT, not just technically verifiable by engineers. Vendor and Platform Engagement Serve as the primary requirements interface with the Partex.AI (Innoplexus) implementation team, ensuring that integration specifications are clearly communicated and that vendor-delivered integrations conform to documented requirements. Assess Partex.AI out-of-the-box capabilities against the client’s integration and data requirements and clearly document the gap between what the platform provides natively and what requires configuration or custom integration work. Track integration delivery against the Q2-Q4 2026 implementation timeline and flag risks or dependencies to the Product Manager and Data and Technology leads. Support the evaluation of Alchemer Enterprise integration requirements, ensuring that survey response data and scoring outputs flow correctly into Partex.AI and that cross-survey intelligence is accessible for site selection decisions. Ongoing Analysis and Governance Monitor integration health and data quality in Partex.AI outputs, working with Data and Technology to diagnose and resolve issues when platform intelligence does not match expected source data. Maintain integration documentation as a living artifact, updated when source systems change, new data sources are added, or business rules are revised. Support UAT and validation activities by producing requirements traceability documentation that maps platform behaviors back to defined integration and data requirements. Identify opportunities to expand the platform's data foundation over time, including new external sources, additional internal operational data, and feedback loop data from completed studies. Qualifications Experience 5+ years as a Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst or Systems Analyst. Experience with data integration requirements, field mapping, and business rules. Strong data quality analysis and agile delivery experience. Experience working in clinical research, pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotechnology or regulated industries. Domain Knowledge Understanding of clinical trial operations and the data generated across the study lifecycle, with particular focus on the feasibility and site selection phase. Familiarity with at least several of the data sources in scope: CTMS, EDC, IRT, Medidata, Citeline, ClinicalTrials.gov, or equivalent clinical data platforms. Understanding of what drives investigator and site selection decisions in a CRO context, including the role of historical performance data, competitive benchmarks, and standard of care alignment. ⚙️ Technical Skills Able to understand schemas, APIs, and basic SQL. Able to create data/process flow documentation. Comfortable analyzing large, multi-source datasets. Familiar with MDM concepts Experience with Project Management tools like Jira, Azure DevOps, or OnePlan. ⭐ Nice to have Experience with clinical, survey, SaaS, EDC/CTMS, or site intelligence platforms. Familiarity with Azure, Databricks, pipelines, GxP/CSV, and lakehouse concepts. Wireframing/mockup experience and BA-related certifications preferred. Additional Information Please note that we will not be moving forward with any applicants who do not meet the following mandatory requirements: +5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst or Systems Analyst. Hands on experience with Jira, Agile/Scrum, Azure DevOps or OnePlan. Experience working at CRO (Contract Research Organization), pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or life sciences companies. Advanced written and spoken English fluency is a MUST HAVE (from B2 level to C1/C2) MUST BE located in Central or South America, as this is a nearshore position (Please note that we are not able to consider candidates requiring relocation or those located offshore). Role Details: Contract type: Independent Contractor (no tax/insurance coverage), gross monthly payment based on hourly rate. Work model: 100% remote. Duration: 9 months initially. (The initial contract runs through end of year with a definite extension expected). Time zone: Full-time, from 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Monday to Friday (EST, USA). Equipment: Contractor must use their own laptop/PC. Process: Interview with Bertoni CV review Technical interview with partner Interview with client Why Join Us? Be part of an innovative team shaping the future of technology. Work in a collaborative and inclusive environment. Opportunities for professional development and career growth.

Title: Business Intelligence Specialist
Industries: Telecommunications and Technology, Information and Media
Description: HONOR es una empresa de tecnología de vanguardia, en este sector los datos se mueven a una velocidad increíble y necesitamos an alguien que no solo lea reportes, sino que prediga tendencias y optimice la toma de decisiones estratégicas. El BI Specialist es el responsable de centralizar, procesar y analizar datos provenientes de diversas fuentes (ventas, inventarios, marketing y mercado) para generar modelos predictivos y tableros de control que guíen la estrategia comercial de HONOR. Su trabajo permite que la empresa reaccione con agilidad ante los cambios del mercado tecnológico. Responsabilidades Principales Generación de Insights Estratégicos: Transformar datos crudos en recomendaciones accionables para las áreas de Ventas, Marketing y Supply Chain. Modelado Predictivo y Forecasting: Desarrollar modelos estadísticos para proyectar la demanda de nuevos lanzamientos y el ciclo de vida de los productos. Automatización de Reporteo: Diseñar y mantener dashboards interactivos que permitan el monitoreo en tiempo real de los KPIs globales y locales. Análisis de Rentabilidad: Evaluar el retorno de inversión (ROI) de las campañas promocionales y la eficiencia de los canales de distribución. Minería de Datos: Identificar patrones de comportamiento del consumidor y anomalías en las tendencias de venta. Perfil Profesional y Estudios Para HONOR, buscamos un perfil con una base matemática sólida y visión de negocio. Las carreras ideales son: Actuaría (Perfil Destacado): Su formación en manejo de riesgos, estadística avanzada y modelos de probabilidad es perfecta para el análisis predictivo en tecnología. Ciencia de Datos / Ingeniería en Tecnologías de la Información: Ideal por la capacidad técnica de manejar grandes volúmenes de datos (Big Data) y programación. Economía / Ingeniería Industrial: Perfiles excelentes para la interpretación de indicadores macroeconómicos y optimización de procesos operativos. Matemáticas Aplicadas: Por su capacidad analítica pura y resolución de problemas complejos. Adicional es importante un manejo de INGLES profesional, para poder presentar reportes a directivos. Para esta posición, el dominio técnico es indispensable. Aquí los detalles: Gestión de Bases de Datos: Dominio avanzado de SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL o SQL Server) para extracción y manipulación de datos. Visualización de Datos Manejo experto de Power BI , Tableau o Google Looker Studio para la creación de tableros. Lenguajes de Programación Conocimiento de Python o R enfocado en análisis estadístico y limpieza de datos (Pandas, NumPy). Análisis Estadístico Conocimientos en regresiones lineales, series de tiempo y modelos de probabilidad (ej. $P(A|B)$ para análisis de afinidad). Requisitos Académicos y de Experiencia Profesional graduado en Ingeniería en Sistemas, Ciencia de Datos, Ciencias de la Computación o carreras afines. Experiencia mínima de 10 años en roles senior de ingeniería de datos, arquitectura de datos o ciencia de datos. Experiencia mínima de 2-3 años trabajando activamente con Databricks y AWS. Deseable contar con certificaciones como Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional o AWS Certified Data Engineer . Idiomas: Inglés avanzado (indispensable para negociaciones con proveedores y adopción de tecnologías globales). Title: Risk Modeling Lead (Líder en Modelado de Riesgo) – Remote
Description: Ready to accelerate your career? Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale. Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices. We're building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas. What you'll do We're looking for a Risk Modeling Lead to strengthen Clara's credit risk capabilities and contribute directly to business resilience and growth. You'll lead the design and implementation of predictive credit risk models , working cross-functionally with Operations , Finance , and Data teams. Your insights will shape credit strategy, drive innovation, and ensure that data and analytics are central to decision-making at Clara. Your responsibilities will include: Leading the development and maintenance of regulatory and strategic risk models, including expected credit loss (ECL) methodologies Supporting portfolio performance and credit strategies with robust data analysis Driving innovation in credit risk analytics to enhance underwriting and monitoring frameworks Monitoring model performance, proposing recalibrations, and coordinating model updates across teams Overseeing Risk MIS: monitoring risk policies, portfolio trends, and key credit metrics Translating data into actionable insights to inform leadership and business decisions Implementing process improvements for greater scalability, transparency, and accuracy Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Must haves Academic background in Actuarial Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field Proven experience in credit risk management in Latin American markets Advanced skills in SQL and data visualization Experience managing the full lifecycle of risk models, from development to backtesting Strong grasp of predictive analytics, risk methodologies, and regulatory compliance Deep commitment to data integrity and hands-on experience with large financial datasets Fluency in English Ability to lead cross-functional projects and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders Nice to haves Experience in fintech, especially in high-growth or startup environments Familiarity with credit cards, payments, and B2B financial solutions Exposure to audit processes and regulatory reporting Understanding of financial conciliation and operational finance systems Knowledge of Latin American regulatory standards Experience working with collaboration tools like Slack, Notion, and Google Drive Passion for building from scratch with a solution-oriented, collaborative mindset Why join Clara At Clara, you'll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America. Who we are We're the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America. Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work, and a LinkedIn Top Startup. Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive. Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive. Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar. Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment. What we believe in #Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively. #Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters. #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told. #Pride. We build products and experiences we're proud of. #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action. #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission. What we offer Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language) Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results If you're ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America. Clara's Hybrid Policy Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team. We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

Title: EY GDS Mexico - Data Engineering

You will align data systems with business goals. You must be self-directed and comfortable supporting the data needs of multiple teams, systems, and products. The ideal candidate should have 3-5 years of experience, Data Engineering, AZURE Cloud, Advanced SQL, Advanced Phyton programming, ETL and ELT Process knowledge, Data structures knowledge, MPP Databases (Teradata, Snowflake), Blob Storage, Azure Data Lake Storage, AZURE cloud. The Data Engineer will interact with different members of the team such as database architects, data analysts, and data scientists on data initiatives and ensure optimal data delivery architecture is consistent with business strategy. Our clients usually have theirs headquarters on USA, however they span across multiple industries, regions, and countries. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering. Title: Research Analyst - Macro Oils
Description: Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape. For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments. Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected. By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe. This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead. Wood Mackenzie Intelligence Connected WoodMac.com Wood Mackenzie Brand Video Wood Mackenzie Values Inclusive – we succeed together Trusting – we choose to trust each other Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions Future Focused – we accelerate change Curious – we turn knowledge into action Role Purpose Wood Mackenzie is a leading provider of data, analytics and insights for the energy, chemicals, metals and mining sectors. We help companies, financial institutions and governments make better strategic decisions by combining industry expertise, proprietary data and advanced analytical capabilities. Within this context, the Macro Oils Team delivers market-leading research, forecasts and data products that help clients understand oil market dynamics and navigate an evolving energy landscape. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to both our research and technical capabilities, supporting the analysis, data infrastructure, models and tools that underpin our products and client solutions. Working closely with analysts, modellers and product teams, you will help ensure our research remains accurate, scalable and impactful while supporting the continued development of our analytical and technology platforms. Main Responsibilities We are looking for an Analyst to join our Global Analyst Team within the Macro Oils Team. This role combines industry research and market analysis with technical ownership of key data, modelling and automation workflows that underpin our research products. The successful candidate will be expected to: Analyse asset, market and industry developments across the commodities and markets they cover, generating short- and long-term forecasts. Gather, validate and interpret industry data to support Wood Mackenzie's market-leading research and analytical products. Connect and build relationships with clients and industry participants to inform analysis and strengthen market understanding. Collaborate with colleagues across Energy and Natural Resources to develop integrated market views and insights. Produce high-quality written analysis on industry developments, including topics such as the Energy Transition, oil-petrochemical integration and sustainability. Contribute to client-facing presentations, discussions and research outputs. Your application should showcase your enthusiasm for the sectors we cover and demonstrate your ability in the following areas, which we require daily at Wood Mackenzie. Research and data gathering – we identify and gather intelligence that feeds our industry expertise. We need inquisitive and passionate people with a keen eye for detail. Analysis - we provide market-leading research using this data/intelligence and form opinions for, and tell stories to, our customers. We need people with natural curiosity with the potential to become experts in their field and with the ability to articulate – both verbally and in writing – clear, insightful analysis. Internal engagement – we work with colleagues across the Wood Mackenzie business to deliver a compelling, integrated view of the natural resources sector to customers through our cutting-edge products. For this, we need people who are as comfortable working collaboratively as they are independently and who have excellent interpersonal skills. External engagement – we proactively connect with our customers and contacts in the industries we serve, adding value and promoting the Wood Mackenzie brand. This requires people with the potential to become industry experts who have intellectual curiosity, passion, and excellent presentation skills. Continuous improvement – at Wood Mackenzie, we are committed to transforming the way we power our planet. The energy transition is here and this impacts our customer base and how we serve them. We need colleagues with a change mindset, who are flexible, growth-orientated and proactive. This includes being open to explore new AI opportunities. AI literacy and critical thinking – comfortable leveraging AI and advanced analytics to enhance research and processes, while exercising sound judgement, validating outputs and understanding the limitations and risks of automated solutions. About You You are an engineer or economist. You will have relevant experience, skills or knowledge that you can apply to the role, allowing you to contribute to our research from day one. Your existing knowledge will enhance our coverage as you develop your career. Keen interest in commodity market dynamics - as someone with a keen interest in commodity market dynamics, you want to understand how these markets impact the natural resources industry and our everyday lives. Analytical mindset and eye for detail - your analytical mindset and attention to detail have been honed through academic and/or work experience. You're comfortable collecting and interpreting data, articulating your findings clearly, and seeking to enhance your knowledge by asking thoughtful questions. You have experience with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, which helps you present your findings in a visually compelling way. Highly adaptive team player - you thrive in fast-paced environments and are excited about the opportunity to work cross-functionally on a variety of tasks. You can work independently or as part of a team, generating ideas and striving to be the best in class. Excellent communication skills - Your strong command of English, both written and spoken, allows you to communicate effectively in the globalised commodity market. Fluency in an additional language would be advantageous. Expectations Growth mindset - taking the initiative to learn new skills, seeking out feedback and coaching, and actively applying what has been learned in the workplace. Change agility - maintaining high performance through disruption and change. We are a hybrid working company and the successful applicant will be expected to be physically present in the office at least 2 days per week to foster and contribute to a collaborative environment, but this may be subject to change in the future. This is a full-time role expected to work early mornings to accommodate collaboration with Europe time-zones. Equal Opportunities We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. You can find out more about your rights under the law at www.eeoc.gov
